errors.evidence: The starting value of the line in 2012 is visually closer to 18,000, being roughly in the middle of the 15,000 and 20,000 grid lines. 17,000 is a noticeable underestimate.

errors.text_span: От 2017 до 2019 г. линията продължава да се покачва, но с по-малък наклон
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization of the trend. The slope from 2017 to 2018 is still quite steep, similar to the preceding period. The slope only becomes noticeably smaller in the final segment from 2018 to 2019.

errors.text_span: достигайки стойност от около 26000 през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: The line in 2019 ends at a value just over the 25,000 grid line. A more accurate approximation is around 25,500. The value of 26,000 is an overestimation.

errors.text_span: В интервала между 2015 г. и 2017 г. се наблюдава част с по-голям наклон.
errors.evidence: This sentence is redundant. It repeats the information provided two sentences earlier: "след което се наблюдава по-стръмен наклон до около 2017 г."
